items.originalTitle: Christian Horner: Kimi Antonelli has 'earned' the right to be Mercedes' number one
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳：基米·安东内利‘赢得’了成为梅赛德斯一号车手的权利
基米·安东内利正在朝着成为F1最年轻世界冠军迈进，并赢得了梅赛德斯选择他作为一号车手而非乔治·拉塞尔的权利
克里斯蒂安·霍纳认为即将成为F1世界冠军的基米·安东内利在2026年的统治表现后，‘赢得’了成为梅赛德斯绝对一号车手的权利
这位20岁的车手在本赛季剩余六轮比赛中领先队友乔治·拉塞尔102分，因此他可以在奥斯汀的下一场比赛中锁定冠军。
安东内利在F1的第二年里就取得了这样的成就，凭借14个领奖台，其中包括8个胜利，同时他在2026年作为夺冠热门的拉塞尔之上。
霍纳认为，如果另一支车队成为威胁，安东内利是领导统治力强大的梅赛德斯车队前进的人选，同时在一个关于车队是否应该优先考虑车手的持续辩论中。
霍纳在2005年至2025年担任车队老板期间，经常支持这种做法，首先是与四届世界冠军塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔，然后是与另一位四届世界冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘，红牛车队在这段时间里一直处于领先地位。
例如，去年迈凯轮采取了截然不同的方法，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂和最终冠军兰多·诺里斯受到了平等对待，但他们几乎被维斯塔潘击败。
或者，正如霍纳所说，1986年威廉姆斯为尼格尔·曼塞尔和纳尔逊·皮克特制造了赢得车队冠军的FW11赛车，他们输给了麦克拉伦的阿兰·普罗斯特的车手冠军。
曼塞尔赢得1986年冠军的希望，在澳大利亚决赛中因爆胎而戏剧性地结束。
“始终让每个人都满意是非常困难的，”霍纳对《Autosport》说。“你只需要诚实，并遵循‘好吧，这里的目的是什么’的原则。”
“最终，团队是第一位的，车手们最终是承包商。承诺两位车手能够赢得世界冠军是不现实的。
“最终，将会有一个车手在赛道上取得优势，他们都有同样的机会，他们都有同样的设备，但你在赛道上的表现决定了你在团队中的尊重和地位。”
“就像现在的基米·安东内利一样。他通过在赛道上的表现赢得了那个团队中的位置，如果他和来自另一个团队的对手之间发生了一场激烈的竞争，团队将不得不采取立场。”
“否则，他们可能会像威廉姆斯队当年在与曼塞尔和皮奎特对抗普罗斯特时那样，失去一项冠军。所以，这就是你如何设定你的赛车计划去比赛。”"
“红牛队总是选择一号车手的动机可能源于2010年，当时维特尔和他的队友马克·韦伯在争夺冠军时经常发生碰撞。”
它几乎让法拉利的费尔南多·阿隆索赢得了那个冠军，但随后从2011年开始，维特尔在韦伯头上确立了统治地位，维斯塔潘也在他的各个队友头上做了类似的事情。
红牛的一切都是围绕着维斯塔潘建立的。
‘在早期，我们是一个年轻的团队，我们刚开始赢比赛，然后随之而来的是胜利带来的所有压力和突然升高的期望，’霍纳补充道。
“媒体的审查和聚光灯都在你身上，一切都被分析到了极致，你只能坚持你的原则。”
“你不能让所有人都一直满意，做对车队最有利的事才是我的职责。”
"我的工作就是做到最好，为红牛车队效力，这意味着赢得比赛。”
detailEn: Christian Horner: Kimi Antonelli has 'earned' the right to be Mercedes' number one
Kimi Antonelli is on course to become F1's youngest world champion and earn the right for Mercedes to pick him as its number-one driver over George Russell
Christian Horner reckons the soon-to-be Formula 1 world champion Kimi Antonelli has ‘earned’ his right to become the outright number-one driver at Mercedes after a dominant 2026.
The 20-year-old holds a 102-point lead over team-mate George Russell in second with six rounds remaining this season, so he can clinch the title in Austin next time out.
Antonelli has achieved this in only his second year of F1 and thanks to 14 podiums including eight wins, while he has had the upper hand on Russell who entered 2026 as the title favourite.
So Horner thinks Antonelli is the man to lead the dominant Mercedes forwards if another squad becomes a threat, amid an ongoing debate over whether teams should prioritise a driver.
Horner’s Red Bull outfit was often in favour of this during his time as team boss from 2005 to 2025, first with Sebastian Vettel and then Max Verstappen - both of whom won four world titles each.
McLaren, for example, had a contrasting approach last year with Oscar Piastri and eventual champion Lando Norris, who were given equal treatment but almost beaten by Verstappen.
Or, as referred to by Horner, in 1986 when Williams produced the constructors’ title-winning FW11 for Nigel Mansell and Nelson Piquet, who lost the drivers’ crown to McLaren’s Alain Prost.
Mansell's hopes of winning the 1986 title dramatically ended with an exploding tyre at the Australia finale
“It's very hard to keep everybody happy all the time,” Horner told Autosport. “You’ve just got to be honest and with the principles of ‘okay, what are the objectives here’.
“At the end of the day, the team is what comes first and the drivers are ultimately contractors. To promise both drivers that you can be able to win a world championship is unrealistic.

“Ultimately there will be one driver that achieves superiority on track and they're both given the same chance, they're both given the same equipment, but you earn the respect and a status within a team by what you do on a track.

“It’s like Kimi Antonelli at the moment. He's earning that position in that team by what he's doing on circuit and if there came to a tight fight between him and a rival from another team, the team would have to take a stance.
“Otherwise they risk losing a championship in the way that Williams potentially did with Mansell and Piquet against Prost all those years ago. So it's just how you set your stall out to go racing.”
The motivation behind Red Bull always picking a number one perhaps stemmed from 2010 when Vettel and team-mate Mark Webber often collided while vying for the title.
It almost led to Ferrari’s Fernando Alonso clinching that championship, but then from 2011 Vettel asserted dominance over Webber with Verstappen doing similar over his various team-mates.
Everything at Red Bull is built around Verstappen
“What it taught me in the early days, we were a young team, we just started winning and then all the pressures that go with winning and the expectations suddenly rise,” added Horner.
“The media scrutiny and the spotlight is on you, everything is being analysed to the nth degree and you've just got to stick to your principles.
“You can't keep everybody happy all of the time and it's doing what is best for the team.
"That's what my job was, I was employed to do the best for Red Bull Racing which meant winning.”
keyPointsZh: 安东内利有望在奥斯汀的下一场比赛中锁定世界冠军头衔。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli is on track to win the world championship at the next race in Austin.

items.originalTitle: 'I felt sorry for Fred' - Horner on Ferrari team boss rumours
items.summaryEn: Christian Horner said he "felt sorry" for Fred Vasseur when speculation surfaced last month linking Horner to replacing the Ferrari Formula 1 team principal.
detailZh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳表示，上月有关他可能接替法拉利F1车队负责人弗雷德·瓦塞尔的传闻出现时，他为瓦塞尔"感到遗憾"。
霍纳接受《泰晤士报》采访的内容在9月法拉利主场蒙扎比赛前完成，他在采访中称法拉利是"F1最大的品牌"、"梦想"和"沉睡的巨人"，该采访发布后引发了霍纳可能接替瓦塞尔的传闻，而瓦塞尔在车队的位置此前一直受到审视。
这甚至促使法拉利召开了一场引人注目的新闻发布会，以平息猜测并公开表态对瓦塞尔有信心。
霍纳在参加《The Race F1 Podcast》节目时被问及与法拉利有关的传闻。
“这一切的时机非常不幸，”霍纳告诉《The Race》。
“我做了一次采访，他们当时正在连载这本书，采访我的是个非常友善的家伙，是刘易斯·汉密尔顿的忠实粉丝。他过来聊了聊，虽然不是这个行业的人，但他是这项运动的粉丝。
“他谈到了不同的车队等等。然后我们聊到了法拉利。法拉利和其他车队不一样。法拉利，你能看到车手和人们是如何高度推崇和尊重它的。我当时是想对法拉利表示尊重。
“这次采访大概是在实际发表前一个月做的。结果碰巧赶上了，我想，是围绕蒙扎或马德里或其他地方发表的一些评论。”
“突然出现了一个标题，在这篇文章上写着‘法拉利是我的梦想’。我其实从未说过那样的话。我是想表达法拉利在这项运动中有着独特的位置，任何为那支车队工作的人都会将其视为一种荣幸。尤其是，我猜想，如果你是一个意大利人的话。”
“突然间，它变成了一件实际上绝非意在给弗雷德施加任何形式压力的事情。但这个标题，加上他们那个世界和他们的车手所发生的一切，制造了这场小风波。”
“我为弗雷德感到难过，因为我曾在一支表现出色的车队、或一支高压车队的前沿工作过，知道其中涉及什么。”
“这只是一个二加二凑成六的问题。”
《泰晤士报》援引霍纳的话说：“我会考虑法拉利吗？我的意思是，法拉利是一级方程式赛车中最大的品牌。这是梦想。而且可以说是F1中沉睡的巨人。”
那么，如果霍纳获得合适的控制权，他真的会考虑法拉利的最高职位吗？
“法拉利在这项运动中就是法拉利，他们拥有巨大影响力的地位，”他说。“而且他们今年显然有一辆很棒的车，或者肯定是底盘；看起来他们在引擎动力上可能有点落后。我认为每个人都希望看到法拉利再次获胜。
“我可能更专注于其他选择。”
“每当你与法拉利联系在一起，那都是极大的荣誉，但这不是我主动去争取的事情。”
霍纳补充道：“我认为在任何组织中，稳定都是关键。”
“我在红牛任职期间，与大概六位、也许七位车队领队同桌而坐，从让·托德一直到弗雷德。”
“稳定至关重要。法拉利作为实质上的国家队，承受着其他车队不会面临的同等审视压力。”
“我认为，看到法拉利在这项运动中获胜会受到所有人的欢迎。我认为弗雷德是一位非常有能力的管理者，我认为他在低级别赛事中有着出色的履历。他可能只是需要更多时间。”
detailEn: Christian Horner said he "felt sorry" for Ferrari Formula 1 team principal Fred Vasseur when speculation linking Horner to replacing him surfaced last month.

The release of an interview Horner conducted with The Times - which took place before Ferrari's tricky home race at Monza in September, and in which he called Ferrari "the biggest brand in Formula 1", "the dream" and a "sleeping giant" - sparked rumours of Horner being a potential candidate to replace Vasseur, whose role at the squad had been under scrutiny.
It even led to a remarkable Ferrari press conference to quash speculation and publicly declare its confidence in Vasseur.
Horner was asked about the rumours linking him to joining Ferrari when he appeared on The Race F1 Podcast.
"The timing of it all was very unfortunate," Horner told The Race.
"I did an interview where they were serialising the book with a very pleasant chap, that was a big Lewis Hamilton fan. He came and had a chat and wasn't from the industry, but was a fan of the sport.

"He was talking about different teams and so on. And we talked about Ferrari. And Ferrari is different to the other teams. Ferrari, you can see the way that drivers and people hold it in huge esteem and with huge respect. And I was trying to be respectful to Ferrari.
"This interview was done about probably a month in advance of when it actually came out. It happened to coincide, I think, with some comments that were made around Monza or Madrid or whatever.

"Suddenly there was a headline that ran on this article that was talking about, 'Ferrari is my dream'. I never actually said that. I was trying to say that Ferrari has its unique place in the sport, and anybody that works for that team would see it as a privilege. Particularly, I assume, if you're an Italian.

"Suddenly it turned into something that was actually not meant in any way to be putting any form of pressure on Fred. But this headline, together with whatever was happening in their world and their drivers, created this bit of a storm.
"I felt sorry for Fred because I've been at the front of a performing team, or a high-pressure team, and know what's involved.
"It was a question of just two and two coming together and adding up to six."
The Times quoted Horner as saying: "Would I consider Ferrari? I mean, Ferrari is the biggest brand in Formula 1. It’s the dream. And arguably it's the sleeping giant of Formula 1."
So would Horner actually consider the top job at Ferrari if he was given the right control?

"Ferrari is Ferrari in the sport and they have a position of huge influence," he said. "And they've obviously had a great car, this year, or certainly the chassis; it looks like they've perhaps been a bit behind on engine power. And I think everybody would love to see Ferrari win again.
"I'm perhaps more focused on other options.
"Whenever you're associated with Ferrari, it's a great honour, but it's not something that I'm petitioning for."
Horner added: "I think within any organisation, stability is key.
"During my time at Red Bull, I sat across the table with maybe six or maybe seven team principals, going back to Jean Todt up to Fred.
"Stability is crucial. Ferrari has a pressure with it, as essentially a national team, that others don't come under the same scrutiny.

"I think that it would be popular for everybody to see Ferrari winning in the sport. I think Fred is a very capable operator, I think he's got a great pedigree in lower forms of racing. He probably just needs more time."
keyPointsZh: 霍纳接受《泰晤士报》采访的内容在9月法拉利主场蒙扎比赛前完成，他在采访中称法拉利是"F1最大的品牌"、"梦想"和"沉睡的巨人"
相关传闻甚至促使法拉利召开新闻发布会，公开表态对瓦塞尔有信心
keyPointsEn: Horner's interview with The Times took place before Ferrari's home race at Monza in September, and in it he called Ferrari "the biggest brand in Formula 1", "the dream" and a "sleeping giant"
The rumours even led to a Ferrari press conference that publicly declared confidence in Vasseur

items.titleZh: 诺里斯在搞笑的UNO对决中败给F1对手
items.summaryZh: F1车手皮埃尔·加斯利、兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在新加坡进行了一场巨型UNO游戏对决。

media.altZh: 诺里斯在搞笑的UNO对决中败给F1对手 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Lando Norris suffers defeat to F1 rivals in hilarious UNO showdown
detailZh: 兰多·诺里斯在搞笑的UNO对决中败给F1对手
兰多·诺里斯、奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里和皮埃尔·加斯利在新加坡进行了一场巨型UNO游戏对决。
奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里、麦克拉伦、兰多·诺里斯、麦克拉伦。
赛车文化超越赛道。车手生活方式、时尚、旅行、设计和让赛车不仅仅是一项运动的故事。
一级方程式车手皮埃尔·加斯利、兰多·诺里斯和奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里在一段视频中展开了一场超级大型的UNO游戏，该视频在不到一天的时间内迅速获得了超过32万的观看次数。
一级方程式在YouTube上发布了这段视频，描述了“麦克拉伦组合”与皮埃尔·加斯利一起在维修区进行了一场超级大型的UNO游戏。
牌的大小大约和标牌一样，游戏开始时要求车手们洗牌。
“哦我的天，它们实际上也很重，”皮亚斯特里在队友观看时说道。‘我不希望伤到自己，’诺里斯开玩笑地说，同时他看着澳大利亚人试图将牌分成几堆来洗牌。规则是标准的UNO，只是牌更大，抽到最大数字的人先手。轮到皮埃尔了。
很快就开始了垃圾话。“别看我的牌了，伙计，”加斯利笑着，车手们在整个游戏过程中互相盯着对方的大手。
加斯利在得到诺里斯的+4之后，首先用完了他的牌，而那些像木瓜一样颜色的车手们开始联合起来对抗他们的阿尔卑斯竞争对手。他很快就结束了游戏，留下两位麦凯轮车手去争夺胜利。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂，麦凯轮，兰多·诺里斯，麦凯轮
“好吧，现在是我对奥斯卡了，”这位现任冠军说。“我们都输了，所以我并不在乎，”皮亚斯蒂补充道。
诺里斯拿着一大堆牌，挣扎着玩，甚至不小心用一张牌打到了自己的脸上。‘他手里有一半的牌，却还是不会玩，’加斯利在皮亚斯特里被迫拿走几张牌后开玩笑说，随着麦凯轮车手再次被迫拿走更多牌，他最终开玩笑地将自己的牌摔到了地上。
然而，游戏很快发生了变化。皮亚斯特里与加斯利合作，成功减少了手中的牌，最终游戏结束时，诺里斯手里拿着牌。
“这是我一生中第一次输的UNO游戏，”他说。
比赛结束后，问车手们对游戏的看法。‘我认为在某些时候，由于牌太多，这是一项两个人的工作，’皮亚斯特里说。‘你需要扔几个……’
“没有太多争议。通常在我家里，圣诞节过得并不太好，”加斯利承认。
本周末的美国大奖赛，诺里斯和皮亚斯特里占据了上风。诺里斯在车手积分榜上以201分排名第六，皮亚斯特里以138分排名第七，而加斯利以41分排名第十，代表阿尔派车队。
detailEn: Lando Norris suffers defeat to F1 rivals in hilarious UNO showdown
Lando Norris, Oscar Piastri and Pierre Gasly took on a giant game of UNO in Singapore
Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
Motorsport culture beyond the track. Driver lifestyle, fashion, travel, design and the stories that make racing more than a sport.
Formula 1 drivers Pierre Gasly, Lando Norris and Oscar Piastri went head to head at a super-sized game of UNO in a video that has quickly racked up more than 320,000 views in less than a day.
Formula 1 posted the clip on YouTube, describing it as “the McLaren duo” being “joined by Pierre Gasly for a game of super-sized UNO in the paddock”.
The cards were roughly the size of a sign board, and the game started with the drivers being asked to shuffle the deck.

“Oh my god, they’re actually heavy as well," Piastri said as his team-mate watched on. "I don’t want to injure myself,” Norris joked as he laughed at the Australian's attempt at separating the cards into piles to shuffle. The rules were standard UNO, just with “extra big cards”, and whoever drew the highest number went first. Enter Pierre.
It did not take long for the trash talk to start. “Stop looking at my cards, man,” Gasly laughed, with the drivers peering at each other’s oversized hands throughout the game.

Gasly got down to his last card first after he got Norris with a +4 and the papaya-coloured drivers were starting to team up against their Alpine competitor. He finished it off soon after, leaving the two McLaren drivers to fight it out.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Oscar Piastri, McLaren, Lando Norris, McLaren
“OK, so it’s me against Oscar now,” the reigning champion said. “We’ve both lost, so I don’t really care," Piastri added.

Norris, holding a huge pile of cards, struggled to play, with him even managing to hit himself in the face with one. “He’s got half the deck in his hand and still can’t play,” Gasly joked after Piastri was forced to pick up several cards, with the McLaren driver eventually jokingly slamming his cards to the floor as he was once again forced to pick up more.
The game quickly changed, however. Piastri, teaming up with Gasly, was able to whittle his hand down and eventually Norris was the one holding cards as the game ended.
“That’s the first ever UNO game I’ve lost in my life,” he said.
The drivers were asked what they thought following the game. “I think it’s a two-person job at some points with so many cards,” Piastri said. “You need to Frisbee a few..."
“Not much argument. Usually with my family it goes down pretty badly over Christmas,” Gasly admitted.

This weekend at the United States Grand Prix, it is Norris and Piastri who hold the upper hand. Norris is sixth in the championship on 201 points and Piastri seventh on 138, while Gasly is 10th on 41 for Alpine.

items.summaryZh: FIA世界汽车运动理事会批准了2027年的新赛事结构，制造商冠军赛将被两项新赛事取代：FIA世界拉力锦标赛车队冠军赛和WRC车队冠军赛。

media.altZh: 2027年FIA世界拉力锦标赛将新增两项冠军 · 第 1 张

items.originalTitle: Two new championships for the FIA WRC in 2027! 🏆 The FIA World Motor Sport Council has approved a new championship structure for 2027, with the Man...
items.summaryEn:
Two new championships for the FIA WRC in 2027! 🏆
The FIA World Motor Sport Council has approved a new championship structure for 2027, with the Manufacturers’ Championship set to be replaced by two new titles:
The FIA WRC Constructors’ Championship: Constructors must compete in every round of the season to be eligible for the title 🌏
WRC Teams’ Championship: Contested over seven nominated events, including a compulsory overseas round and the season finale 👀
Both championships will be exclusive to the Rally1 category 🔥
#FIA #WRC
detailZh:
2027年FIA世界拉力锦标赛将新增两项冠军！🏆
FIA世界汽车运动理事会已批准2027年的新赛制，制造商锦标赛将被两项新冠军取代：
FIA世界拉力锦标赛车队冠军：车队必须参加每轮比赛才有资格获得该冠军 🌏
WRC车队冠军：在七个指定的赛事中进行争夺，包括一个强制性的海外赛事和赛季决赛 👀
两项冠军都将仅限于Rally1类别 🔥
#FIA #WRC
